<div class="card-body">
'''Alderaan''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オルデラン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、支配しているデス・スターの位置１つにつき、フォース消耗を＋１する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-281o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Alderaan.

'''Dark Side:''' If you control here, add 1 to the Force drain for each Death Star site you control.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese counts each Death Star site you control; English requires those sites on table also in your control.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Alderaan (Dark)|Alderaan]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
